scope: PR02 Box3D-compatible public/native/body compound AABBs; no ownership/solver/broadphase scheduling change
hypothesis: Resolve public children, union their tight local AABBs, transform parent enclosing box once, then pad; use same result for public/body/native snapshots. Noncompound bounds retain existing semantics.
order: Build and freeze ordinary/native libraries and tests; build all C fixtures. Contract ordinary/native/native/ordinary (two fresh each), C regressions settings ordinary/native then replacement ordinary/native, Rust query suite ordinary/native then native diagnostic suite ordinary/native. Serial, no competing GPU work.
settings: Same NVIDIA Vulkan/order1/native cache settings as completed bounds diagnosis. C contract uses unchanged defaults/static compound, all four child kinds, unrotated/rotated bodies, two generations, creation/body transform/disable/enable, parent stale IDs. Construction/query only; no solver step added. Existing regression settings unchanged.
acceptance: Public shape, native owned parent bounds and body AABB match independent b3ComputeCompoundAABB plus original speculative padding and mapped CPU shape/body at absolute1e-5 in all cases. No zero substitute, no weaker containment criterion. Stale parent public bounds zero and CPU/GPU parent handles invalid. Existing query and diagnostics assertions remain unchanged. Known duplicate CPU children are not qualified by this bounds-only campaign.
stop_rule: Stop first build/contract/regression failure; retain completed/unlaunched results, restore three production files if rejected. No rerun/replacement/tolerance/budget extension. Record affected scenes separately before committing any retained solver/visual change.
separate_recordings: AABB API/diagnostics do not feed solver/broadphase. Audit render/caller scope before commit; preserve CPU-first grid and freeze a finite native recording protocol if affected views require captures.
